text: Just after someone presses a button, a product keeps its promise, or quietly breaks it.
What decides it is rarely on the screen.
We build both sides of that moment.
Automation carries the busywork, and a person still approves what matters.
Releases go out on an ordinary afternoon, and nobody holds their breath.
When a storage node goes dark in AegisStore, the files keep coming back, verified.
Good engineering rarely asks to be noticed. It simply holds.
